content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Self-attested copies of all academic certificates and mark sheets of all examinations passed. Research publications, with a separate sheet listing the title, author(s), journal, volume, pages and NAAS rating. For papers that have been accepted, attach a copy of the Chief Editor's / Editor's acceptance letter with the manuscript. Experience certificate, caste certificate and PwD certificate, if any. Proof of age. A duly signed photocopy of the fee deposit receipt, with your full signature on the back, and the original counterfoil of the fee deposited, signed by you. Two recent passport size attested photographs. Also paste a recent passport size colour photograph on the form. A typed score card from the information sheet with three added columns: Self-assessed score, Reference page no. and Score assigned by the Screening Committee. Documents for API Score Card no. 3 (A/B/C) and 4B must be certified by the Competent Authority. All other documents needed to support your claim. In-service candidates must produce a No Objection Certificate (NOC) from their employer at the time of document verification / written test. Without it, the candidature will not be considered.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection is based on a total weighted score made up of academic records, a written test, research publication and a viva-voce. The written test and interview are held at Bhubaneswar, and candidates attend at their own cost. Research publication: only the best one publication is considered. It gets a weightage of 2 for a NAAS rating of 4-6, 6 for a rating above 6-8, and 10 for a rating above 8. Mention your best paper with its NAAS rating in the form. Based on the score out of 80 (academic records, written test and publication), four times the number of advertised posts will be called for interview from the top scorers. The interview score is added to the score out of 80 to rank the candidates.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for OUAT Assistant Professor Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the Registrar, OUAT, Bhubaneswar on or before 5.00 PM on 7 December 2026. Late applications will not be entertained.

faq.question: Q2. How many Assistant Professor posts are there in Poultry Science?
faq.answer: There are 4 posts in Poultry Science. The vacancies for the other subjects are shown against each discipline in the advertisement table.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is required?
faq.answer: Candidates need a minimum 2nd Class Bachelor's and Master's Degree with at least 55% marks / equivalent OGPA in the subjects specified for the post. They also need NET with one NAAS-rated publication, or a Ph.D. with course work and two NAAS-rated publications (rating not less than 4).

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The limit is 42 years for general candidates as on the last date of the application. Reserved candidates get a relaxation (5 years for Poultry Science; as per Government norms for the other subjects), and there is no upper age limit for OUAT employees.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of OUAT Assistant Professor (Poultry Science)?
faq.answer: The pay is Cell-1, Level-10, Rs.57,700/-, with the usual DA and other allowances as admissible.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: The fee is Rs.700/- and is non-refundable. It is deposited through GCC, Internet Banking or RTGS into the Comptroller, OUAT account (A/C No. 10173711536, SBI OUAT Campus Branch, IFSC SBIN0003341).

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Send the completed form with self-attested documents and the signed fee receipt by Speed Post or Registered Post to the Registrar, OUAT, Bhubaneswar-751003, Odisha. The envelope must be superscribed "APPLICATION FOR THE POST OF ______" with the advertisement number and date.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: Selection is based on Academic Records (40%), Written Test (30%), Research Publication (10%) and Viva-Voce (20%). Four times the number of advertised posts are called for interview based on the score out of 80.

faq.question: Q9. Can I apply for more than one subject?
faq.answer: Yes. You must submit a separate application for each post, with the fee deposited separately.

faq.question: Q10. Can candidates who have only appeared for NET apply?
faq.answer: Yes. They can apply with an undertaking to produce the NET Clearance Certificate on the date of interview.
